findings.title: Session cookie 'session_id' missing security flags
findings.evidence: Flags missing: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite; Set-Cookie: session_id=probe_sess_12345; Path=/
findings.remediation: Set 'HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax' on all session cookies.

findings.title: Form missing anti-CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form at http://127.0.0.1:8765 contains inputs ['username', 'password'] without CSRF token
findings.remediation: Implement anti-CSRF tokens or SameSite=Lax/Strict cookie protection on POST forms.

findings.title: Form missing anti-CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form at http://127.0.0.1:8765/login contains inputs ['username', 'password'] without CSRF token
findings.remediation: Implement anti-CSRF tokens or SameSite=Lax/Strict cookie protection on POST forms.
